sample_unit: patients (eICU demo N=200; MIMIC-IV demo N=117)

links.outcome: Performance drop from internal eICU evaluation to external MIMIC-IV validation (domain shift)
links.effect: eICU internal accuracy 0.970 (95% CI 0.945-0.990), F1 0.966; external MIMIC-IV validation showed severe performance degradation.
links.quote: However, external validation on the MIMIC-IV cohort revealed severe performance degradation.

links.outcome: Model robustness to input/schema formatting variation
links.effect: Framework showed structural formatting fragility and domain shift on out-of-distribution EHR data.
links.quote: While the dual-model framework provides highly accurate and interpretable AKI alerts on familiar schema cohorts, it suffers from structural formatting fragility and domain shift.

unlisted_practices: Training predictive models on differentially private synthetic data (ε=10)

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel agentic dual-model (LLM + time series) architecture for predicting AKI, demonstrating performance degradation on external validation due to schema/domain shift.
